answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The lantern lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the delta is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
